_about: Expected site error budget: how far a sensor at OUR exact site may differ from the Open-Meteo grid data. Used by the website (shaded bands, tag 'W±') and by twin/uncertainty_2026.py. One place for all numbers.
statement: These are expected differences between Open-Meteo grid data and a sensor at our exact site, taken from published studies. They are not our measurements.
label: expected range from published studies – not measured

temp_C.name: Outside air temperature
temp_C.source: ERA5 vs weather stations: hourly RMSE about 1–2 °C (WeatherReal benchmark 2024; IMD 458-station evaluation 2025); coastal Tmax/Tmin biases are larger (J. Earth Syst. Sci. 131:179, 2022).
temp_C.why: Open-Meteo gives the average of a grid box about 25–30 km wide; our sensor sits at one spot. On sunny, calm afternoons the ground and the sheet-metal walls heat the air near the sensor, so the error can double.

dewpoint_C.name: Dew point
dewpoint_C.why: Humidity near the coast changes over short distances (sea breeze); the grid box mixes sea and land air.

rh_pct.name: Outside relative humidity
rh_pct.rule: Not a flat %: the band is worked out from the temperature band and the dew-point band (RH = e(Td)/e(T)). Typically ±5–15 %RH per hour, ±3–8 %RH per day.
rh_pct.source: Follows from the temperature and dew-point errors above.
rh_pct.why: Relative humidity depends on the air temperature: a small temperature error moves RH a lot.

ghi_rel.name: Solar irradiance (sunlight)
ghi_rel.source: ERA5 daily RMSE about 21 W/m² over India (Atmosphere 2025); hourly relative RMSE about 41 % in the humid tropics (Remote Sensing 2026).
ghi_rel.why: The model can put a cloud in the wrong hour or the wrong place; on clear days it is close, on cloudy days much less so.

wind_ms.name: Wind speed at 2 m
wind_ms.source: ERA5 10 m wind compared with stations; converted to 2 m with FAO-56.
wind_ms.why: Open-Meteo gives wind at 10 m height over a smooth grid box; at 2 m beside a building, trees and the room itself slow and gust the wind.

pressure_hPa.name: Air pressure
pressure_hPa.source: BME280 sensor specification (±1 hPa) and the height correction between the grid box and the site.
pressure_hPa.why: Pressure is smooth in space; the only differences are the height of the site and the sensor's own accuracy.

pv_energy_rel.name: Solar electricity (PV)
pv_energy_rel.source: Follows the sunlight error above, plus dust (soiling) on the panels.
pv_energy_rel.why: Solar power is almost proportional to sunlight, and dust on the glass takes a few per cent more.

random_runs.note: Each hour's error is drawn from a normal distribution whose standard deviation is the hourly band, correlated over about 6 hours (AR(1), phi = exp(-1/6)) so errors persist like real weather errors.
